mapper.select: SELECT menu_id AS "menuId", upr_menu_id AS "parentId", menu_nm AS name, scrn_id AS "screenId", icon_nm AS icon, mbl_expsr_yn='Y' AS mobile FROM sys.menu WHERE use_yn='Y' ORDER BY sort_seq, menu_id
SELECT cls_ym AS month, cls_stts_cd AS status FROM fin.mth_cls WHERE cls_ym BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY cls_ym
SELECT max(cls_ym) FROM fin.mth_cls WHERE cls_stts_cd='CLOSED'
mapper.sql: g.cd_grp_id,g.cd_grp_nm,g.cd_grp_se_cd,g.attr1_nm,g.attr2_nm,g.attr3_nm,g.sort_seq,g.use_yn,(SELECT count(*) FROM cmn.cd_dtl d WHERE d.cd_grp_id=g.cd_grp_id) AS "codeCount"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM cmn.cd_grp g ORDER BY sort_seq,cd_grp_id
SELECT FROM cmn.cd_grp g WHERE g.cd_grp_id=#{group}
SELECT dtl_cd,cd_nm,attr1_val,attr2_val,attr3_val,sort_seq,use_yn,to_char(aply_bgn_dt,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS aply_bgn_dt FROM cmn.cd_dtl WHERE cd_grp_id=#{group} ORDER BY sort_seq,dtl_cd
SELECT dtl_cd AS code,cd_nm AS name,attr1_val AS attr1,attr2_val AS attr2,attr3_val AS attr3 FROM cmn.cd_dtl WHERE cd_grp_id=#{group} AND use_yn='Y' ORDER BY sort_seq,dtl_cd
mapper.update: UPDATE cmn.cd_dtl cd_nm=#{changes.cd_nm}, sort_seq=#{changes.sort_seq}, use_yn=#{changes.use_yn}, attr1_val=#{changes.attr1_val,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, attr2_val=#{changes.attr2_val,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, attr3_val=#{changes.attr3_val,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, aply_bgn_dt=CAST(#{changes.aply_bgn_dt,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS date), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{actor,jdbcType=BIGINT} WHERE cd_grp_id=#{cd_grp_id} AND dtl_cd=#{dtl_cd}
mapper.sql: FROM cmn.excel_map m JOIN cmn.cd_grp g ON g.cd_grp_id=m.trns_cd_grp_id JOIN cmn.cd_dtl d ON d.cd_grp_id=m.trns_cd_grp_id AND d.dtl_cd=m.trns_cd
mapper.update: UPDATE cmn.excel_map map_role_cd=#{changes.map_role_cd}, rmrk_desc=#{changes.rmrk_desc,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, use_yn=#{changes.use_yn}, WHERE map_id=CAST(#{map_id} AS bigint)
mapper.select: SELECT h.cd_grp_id,CASE WHEN h.cd_grp_id='PARAM' THEN '기준값' ELSE g.cd_grp_nm END AS cd_grp_nm,h.dtl_cd,h.cd_chg_ty_cd,h.item_nm,h.bfr_val,h.aft_val,h.chg_user_id,to_char(h.chg_at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS chg_at FROM cmn.cd_hist h LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_grp g ON g.cd_grp_id=h.cd_grp_id h.cd_grp_id=#{group} ORDER BY h.chg_at DESC,h.cd_hist_id DESC
SELECT DISTINCT ON (oprt_std_id) FROM cmn.oprt_std WHERE aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} ORDER BY oprt_std_id,aply_bgn_ym DESC
SELECT FROM cmn.oprt_std WHERE oprt_std_id=#{key} ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC
SELECT FROM cmn.oprt_std WHERE oprt_std_id=#{key} AND aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cmn.oprt_std(oprt_std_id,aply_bgn_ym,oprt_std_nm,num_val,txt_val,unit_nm,use_plc_desc,created_by) VALUES(#{oprt_std_id},#{aply_bgn_ym},#{oprt_std_nm},#{num_val,jdbcType=DECIMAL},#{txt_val,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{unit_nm,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{use_plc_desc,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{actor,jdbcType=BIGINT}) ON CONFLICT(oprt_std_id,aply_bgn_ym) DO UPDATE SET num_val=EXCLUDED.num_val,txt_val=EXCLUDED.txt_val
